title: Everywear: In Everywhere, For Every Wear!
description:
Everywear enables you to connect the creator’s digital outfits to every avatar and digital space. Creators can easily optimize outfits designed in CLO and Marvelous Designer to suit digital spaces such as games, metaverse, and entertainment through EveryWear. 

Update either your CLO or Marvelous Designer and experience EveryWear. 
✅ CLO: https://www.clo3d.com/en/clo/download
✅ MD: https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/learn/newfeature

Learn how to use EveryWear exclusively on our YouTube:
✅ EveryWear Tutorial: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wKjp2Xo0VCQ
✅ EveryWear to VRChat Tutorial: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NZjvXlFYem8
